edit_instruction: Change the background to a concrete underground bunker hallway with flickering overhead fluorescent lights and steam venting from pipes, under cool, high-contrast lighting from the left. Medium shot, eye-level, blurred background. Keep the soldier in desert camo intact.

Change the background to a warm, sunlit living room with family photos on the wall and sheer white curtains billowing softly at an open window, with dust motes dancing in light beams and soft window light from the left. Medium shot, eye-level, blurred background. Keep the soldier and his two sons intact.

Change the background to the atrium of a luxurious multi-story shopping mall with a glass elevator rising in the distance and water rippling in a decorative indoor fountain, lit by soft diffused skylight from the front-left. Medium wide shot, eye-level, static camera, soft-focus background with bokeh from shop lights. Keep the blonde woman with shopping bags intact.
Add a young woman wearing white headphones dancing and snapping her fingers, lit by soft neutral light from the front-left. Eye-level, medium shot, static camera.
Add a young girl in winter clothing making a peace sign, illuminated by soft festive artificial light from the front-right. Medium shot, eye-level, static camera.
Add a man sitting on a plush rug explaining himself to a woman standing with crossed arms, lit by soft neutral light. Eye-level, full shot, static camera.

Add a young girl with long brown hair, wearing a white patterned sleeveless top and denim shorts with white-rimmed sunglasses perched on her head, sitting on a wooden bench next to a fluffy white and brown Border Collie, affectionately wrapping her arms around the dog's neck and hugging it tightly while leaning her cheek against the dog's head, the dog sits calmly panting slightly with its tongue out, soft natural daylight, diffused and even lighting, neutral color temperature. Medium shot, telephoto lens feel, eye-level angle, static camera, slightly blurred background.

Add a diverse group of five joyful young friends laughing and swaying while waving burning sparklers in the air creating trails of light, blue hour ambient light with warm interactive lighting from sparklers, high contrast. Medium shot, normal lens, eye-level, handheld camera movement, slightly blurred background.
Add a cowboy in a plaid shirt leading a dark horse walking, hard warm golden hour light from the right. Medium shot, eye-level, tracking camera, blurred background with bokeh.

Change the background to a dirt path cutting through a misty forest with tall bare pine trees and frost-covered grass, creating a moody atmospheric setting with soft diffuse cool-toned daylight filtering through the mist, shot as a low angle full shot with a tracking forward motion and slightly blurred background. Keep the man in dark tactical gear intact.

Change the background to a textured sandy beach with calm blue water extending to the horizon and a faint city skyline visible in the distance under a blue sky with scattered clouds, with natural bright daylight, high contrast, and hard light casting distinct shadows, shot as a full shot, eye-level tracking shot with deep focus. Keep the barefoot dancer in a white shirt and black trousers intact.

Change the background to a bright hallway, a long narrow corridor lined with floor-to-ceiling windows covered in sheer white curtains on the left and warm wood paneling with large potted plants on the right, lit by soft diffused daylight creating cool-toned illumination, shot as a medium shot with a wide-angle lens feeling and slight handheld camera shake. Keep the two female dancers intact.

Add a white swan entering from the left edge and swimming smoothly across the lower-left foreground, facing right in profile view. The swan holds its neck in a curved posture and moves steadily past a small duck, its white feathers contrasting with the dark water under soft, diffuse daylight. Wide shot, eye-level, sharp background.

Add two men in traditional clothing walking side-by-side from right to left along the barriers, facing left in profile view. The figure closer to the camera wears a brown bisht over a white thobe, while the other wears an all-white thobe and headscarf. They move at a steady pace, casting distinct shadows to the left on the sunlit asphalt. High-angle full shot, sharp background.

Add a woman with long wavy brown hair wearing a loose, white button-down shirt walking slowly away from the camera in the center of the frame. She is barefoot, facing away, moving across the wet sand which mirrors her figure in a clear, elongated reflection below. Full shot, eye-level, sharp background.
